name: LPC transfer to oneself credits the balance read before the debit
summary: LPC's transfer reads the recipient balance before deducting the sender and writes it back increased, with no check that sender and recipient differ, so a transfer to oneself adds the amount without removing it. The attacker flash-swapped LPC from the LPC/USDT pair, multiplied it with self-transfers, repaid the pair and in the next transaction sold the minted LPC into the LPC/USDT and LPC/BNB pairs.
notes: The anchor minted LPC; the sale one minute later (campaign) drained the pairs. The owner had renounced ownership at block 17,356,026; earlier owner changes only set fees.
Loss is the two pairs' USDT and BNB outflows; the minted LPC is valued at nothing (rule 12).
